title: Hold working with children checks
what: Make sure people doing child-related work hold the state's working with children check (or equivalent).

sources.title: Child Safety (Prohibited Persons) Act 2016 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 18—Employer to ensure working with children check conducted at least every 5 years (1) An employer must not continue to employ a person in a prescribed position unless a working with children check has been conducted in relation to the person within the preceding 5 years.

reach.note: Schools, child care, and sport, arts and tutoring instruction.

sources.title: Working with children check
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need a Working with Children Check if you are 14 years of age or over and you do: child-related work as a volunteer or employee for more than seven days a year any child-related work that involves overnight stays, or close personal contact with a child with a disability.

reach.condition: if its people do child-related work

assessment.summary: People doing child-related work need the state or territory's working with children check.

marks.reason: Checks and their renewal for staff and volunteers in child-related work.
A check from one state is generally not valid in another, so people working across borders need several.
